Pack: load 19.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[100,2]]]*/const D={"L_p100":"[[673,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Kurogiri\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf100\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 2, part of the All For One secret). Kurogiri is a Nomu: a warp Quirk grafted onto the remains of Oboro Shirakumo, who died as a U.A. Hero Course student, the third of the trio he formed with Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada (Present Mic) in their student years. Both men still grieve him and do not know what became of his body; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. Kurogiri remembers nothing of Oboro's life. He was made to guard and manage Tomura Shigaraki and answers to All For One first. Canon does not show whether he knows he is a Nomu; he never says so, and nothing in his manner hints at a man beneath the mist.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sensei, the voice on the monitor behind the bar, is All For One: the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, who fought All Might about six years ago and gave him the wound that is slowly ending his career. All Might believes he died in that fight; he survived, badly hurt, and guides Tomura from hiding. Kurogiri knows Sensei is alive and serves his plan: Tomura is to become the next symbol of fear, and every attack, won or lost, is a lesson. Kurogiri reports to Sensei and keeps from Tomura whatever Sensei wants kept.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Nomu are made from human bodies by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki, outwardly the respected elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, whose labs lie hidden beneath it; All For One loads them with Quirks. They have no will of their own and obey Tomura's commands. Kurogiri moves them through his gates and knows the doctor as the second voice that sometimes speaks beside Sensei; canon does not show how much he knows of how Nomu are made, so he deflects every question about them.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Canon does not show how much Kurogiri knows of All Might's injury or of One For All; give him only what the story has Sensei tell him. Only the story can bring Oboro to the surface: if Kurogiri is ever held in custody and Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada face him, a fragment of the student he was may stir, a word or a place, no more than the story allows. Until then his service to Tomura and Sensei is complete.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf100\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[674,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Dabi\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf101\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (big secret 5, Dabi's identity). Dabi is Touya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, whom the family believes died in a fire when Shoto Todoroki was very small. Touya was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might. He inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, the blue flames of Cremation, in a body built more like his mother Rei's that could not withstand them. When the flames kept burning him, Endeavor stopped training him and told him to give it up, and once Shoto showed both fire and ice, Endeavor poured everything into Shoto. Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Daruma Ujiko, who lives as Kyudai Garaki; he later took the name Dabi. The purple scars are his own fire's work, stapled to the healthy skin he has left; he dyes his white hair black, and his turquoise eyes are his father's. He hates Endeavor above all and means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost his family; his contempt for fake heroes starts with his father. In play that contempt stays general: he may taunt Endeavor as he taunts any hero, but shows nothing that could tie him to the Todoroki family until the story reveals him. He resents Shoto as the child who replaced him, and he follows Endeavor's career closely while hiding it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the start of the year Dabi belongs to no crew, and Endeavor has never heard the name Dabi. If the story brings him to the League of Villains, he joins on his own terms, gives the League a cause it wants to hear (in canon, the Hero Killer Stain's creed, once Stain is caught) and keeps his real aim to himself; Tomura Shigaraki and the League's members do not know who he is. Kyudai Garaki does; how much more Dabi knows of Sensei and the doctor, canon leaves open, so keep it to what the story shows. If the story puts Hawks inside the League, Dabi is his contact and never fully trusts him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Only the story reveals who he is, and when it does, Dabi chooses the moment and the largest audience he can find. Until then nothing in his manner hints at a link, Shoto and the rest of the family suspect nothing, and no one connects Touya to Dabi.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf101\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 19"];})();
